title: Assisted Shopping Studio
prompt: Design a highly polished, believable desktop SaaS application SCREENSHOT for ABI agent marketplace, direction 2 'Assisted Shopping Studio'. This is an OPERATING console, not a landing page, not a website hero, no device frame, landscape 3:2 aspect. Deliberately different topology than a standard sidebar-plus-product-grid: a narrow 76px midnight-navy icon rail at far left, a horizontal workspace bar with ABI and Buy / Sell navigation, a left 340px shopping-brief and agent-progress column, and a large right comparison workspace filling the remaining width. Calm cool-white #f5f7fa canvas, white panels, dark navy #182b43 text, clear muted steel secondary type, restrained cobalt #315dd8 primary actions; excellent spacing, 24px gutters, precise IBM Plex Sans-like sans typography, clear 14px body, small quiet toolbar labels. Top bar 'ABI / Demo workspace', Shopping selected, Orders, Inventory, Fulfillment, Approvals, Settings accessible. Main title 'A hiking gift, handled thoughtfully.' and nearby explicit status 'Demo scenario · fictional listings'. Left column heading 'Your shopping brief', readable input text 'Find a green daypack and a trail guide under 95 USDC.', budget control 95.00 USDC, delivery preference 3–5 days; primary 'Find matching products'. Under that a concrete progress timeline 'Checked product details', 'Compared available stock', 'Quote ready to review'. A short plain assistant message 'The daypack and guide fit your budget. Review the two sellers before checkout.' No fabricated live assistant claims; visibly demo. Right workspace header 'Compare your options', compact filter controls. Two substantial side-by-side open product comparison columns with realistic studio photographs: forest-green hiking backpack named 'Trailhead daypack' from 'Northline Supply', price 68.00 USDC, available 14, 22 L, recycled nylon, water resistant, color Forest green, estimated 3–5 days; second product a digital PDF cover titled 'Weekend trail guide' from 'Northline Digital', price 12.00 USDC, 40 routes, instant demo download. Each column has Add to shortlist control. A compact lower table compares color, stock, delivery, license with aligned rows, no unnecessary metric cards. Bottom sticky purchase review bar spans comparison workspace with '2 items · 2 sellers', Products 80.00, Shipping 6.00, Total 86.00 USDC, budget remaining 9.00, primary 'Review demo quote', quiet 'Simulation only · no money moves'. Fine dividers, not heavy card nesting. Use meaningful focused controls, subtle selected states, no decorative charts, no gradients, no glowing glass. Demonstrate rich product content and clarity rather than giant headings. Edge-to-edge app composition.
notes: Concept only. Demo progress is simulated; implementation must not add unsupported live assistant capabilities or inferred licenses.
approval: User selected exactly the blue version and confirmed implementation on 2026-11-07.
